idea-plugin.name: SOTheme
idea-plugin.description:
Dark and light Islands UI themes with syntax color schemes for PHP, Blade, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

  • SOTheme Dark: deep navy workspace with violet accents, balanced contrast, and tailored terminal colors.
  • SOTheme Light: warm cream workspace with high-contrast dark text and readable terminal ANSI colors.

Built on top of the Islands UI architecture (Islands Dark and Islands Light) for clean visual hierarchy across editor tabs, tool windows, diffs, and the block terminal.

Türkçe: Islands arayüzü üzerine kurulu SOTheme Dark (lacivert zemin, mor vurgu) ve SOTheme Light (sıcak krem zemin, yüksek kontrast) tema ailesi; PHP, Blade, HTML, CSS ve terminal için özel renk şemaları içerir.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.2.0: Switched to native Islands Dark and Islands Light parent theme inheritance for full compatibility with 2026.2 and 2026.3+ IDEs.
  • Added require-restart="true" to prevent dynamic theme unload class loader leaks (IJPL-261778).
  • Updated plugin icon, English description, and Marketplace metadata.
